products.name: Premium Stone-Ground Sharbati Atta (Whole Wheat Flour)
products.description: Freshly milled from high quality MP Sharbati wheat grains. Stone-ground (Chakki) to preserve nutrition, dietary fibers, and natural taste. Standard choice for super soft and delicious rotis.

products.name: Premium Stone-Ground Sharbati Atta
products.description: Freshly milled stone-ground premium MP Sharbati wheat flour. Rich in dietary fiber, clean, and nutritious. Pack of 5 kg.

products.name: Fresh Pure Chana Besan (Gram Flour)
products.description: 100% pure chana dal ground flour. Perfect for pakoras, laddoos, and traditional breakfast recipes. Gluten-free and loaded with high protein.

products.name: Royal Premium Basmati Rice (Aged)
products.description: Long grain aged aromatic basmati rice. Ideal for biryanis, pulao, and festive meals. Aged for 12+ months to achieve perfect fluffiness.

products.name: Unpolished Organic Toor Dal
products.description: Unpolished, organically grown pigeon pea lentils (Arhar Dal). No chemical or synthetic colors added. Retains native nutrients and provides high dietary fibers.

products.name: Fresh Full Cream Cow Milk (Pack of 2)
products.description: Farm-fresh high fat cow milk, pasteurized and packed securely. Pasteurized within 4 hours of milking. (2x 500ml packets)

products.name: Pure Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil (Kachi Ghani)
products.description: Extracted from premium native black mustard seeds using traditional cold-press mills. Highly pungent aroma, authentic taste, completely raw and unrefined.

products.name: Pure Desi Cow A2 Bilona Ghee
products.description: Traditional Bilona churned ghee prepared from pure grass-fed A2 cow milk. Loaded with standard vitamins, high butyric acid, and heavenly granular aroma.
